repos.notes: SPL Token-2022 JS client. js@v0.17.0 renamed the program node to its canonical camelCase name and swapped the generated extension array for a hand-written TLV codec that stops at the first Uninitialized header, so accounts with unused extension space (including two-byte multisig padding) decode instead of throwing. js@v0.19.0 only bumps the Codama JS renderer and regenerates the TypeScript client; idl.json is byte-identical, so the Dart output is unchanged

repos.name: mpl-bubblegum
repos.notes: Metaplex Bubblegum Anchor IDL at idls/bubblegum.json; convert with @codama/nodes-from-anchor before rendering. Pinned to the Core/Rust client release tag release/bubblegum@2.0.0 rather than a default-branch commit: the tag is the newest immutable ref that carries the DAS inherited-SFBP work (JS client v6.0.0 leaf metadata, commit 79e1a195), and the four commits between it and main only touch CI release workflows and crate manifests. The JS client's own v6.0.0 release is untagged, so this tag is the closest versioned pin upstream publishes.
